phases.goal: Move one white shoe into the orange box.
phases.name: place_first_shoe
phases.verify: First shoe is inside the box.

phases.goal: Move the second shoe into the box with tips left-aligned.
phases.name: place_second_shoe
phases.verify: Both shoes are inside the box with aligned tips.

phases.name: retreat_clear
phases.verify: Both shoes remain inside the orange box.

semantic_recipe.relation_to_jsonl: Phases are transferable task guidance; the companion JSONL is the exact historical winning command sequence.

strategy_notes.coordinate_policy: Relocalize all objects, supports, contacts, and poses from current observations; do not reuse s0 coordinates.
critical_gates: First shoe remains inside the box.
Second shoe is placed without disturbing the first.
Tips are left-aligned before final retreat.

roles.protected: first shoe remains inside while second is placed

task_language: Transfer two the white shoe with rounded toe, tips left-aligned, into the smooth bright orange box.
vla_recipe: Exact sequence: 1:lingbot_act(chunks=2,use_length=50); 2:lingbot_act(chunks=3,use_length=50); 3:move_to(arm=right,gripper=open,orientation=keep). For every lingbot_act, use the original task_language exactly; relocalize every pose from current observations; do not replay clean coordinates.

notes: Avoid correcting the shoe already inside the box; relocalize the outside shoe and verify both shoes remain contained with their tips left-aligned.
